limits: n=5 per arm; matched control on identical topology and identical impairment.
The impaired segment was never repaired and the netem qdisc was never removed. The action changes which segment the receiver uses.
This is a packet-observation outcome. It is NOT a clock-error, timing-quality, service-restoration or physical-recovery measurement.
Shared host software clock under free_running 1.
The post-trigger observation window differs per run; it is reported per run.
The capture-time trigger split is not a measured post-takeover or post-command interval: no cross-clock mapping to the ptp4l transition log was recorded.
